records.japanese:
ありがたいね
有効に使わせてもらいますよ
records.current_English: Thanks. We'll put it to good use.
records.english: Thanks. We'll put it to good use.{PAD}
records.speaker: Market Trader, original contextual town merchant
records.context: OriginalBC894 investment path selects763 when local share is positive,762 otherwise; available funds are compared with the native minimum before748; positive supplied amount leads747, zero leads746.
records.source_meaning: The merchant appreciates the investment and says it will be put to effective use.
records.localization_note: Retain the natural thanks and effective-use promise. Collective business we remains appropriate; no effect size is invented.

records.japanese:
うんっ！？
申し訳ないが、その金額じゃ
どうにもならんよ
もっと稼いだら、また来てくれよ
records.current_English:
Sorry, but that won't be enough.
  Come back when you've earned more.
records.english: Huh? Sorry, but that's not enough to work with. Come back when you've earned more.{PAD}
records.speaker: Market Trader, original contextual town merchant
records.context: OriginalBC894 investment path selects763 when local share is positive,762 otherwise; available funds are compared with the native minimum before748; positive supplied amount leads747, zero leads746.
records.source_meaning: Surprised apology that the available amount will not suffice; asks the player to return after earning more.
records.localization_note: Restore the surprised reaction and inability to proceed. Not enough to work with preserves the objection without inventing how far below the exact threshold the available money is.

records.japanese:
積荷倉庫が満杯だよ！
買うものを減らしてくれよ
records.current_English: Cargo holds are full. Buy less.
records.english: Your cargo holds are full! You'll have to buy less.{PAD}
records.speaker: Market Trader, original contextual town merchant
records.context: Original Market source explicitly binds the cargo-capacity warning749 or transaction funds warning753 to the direct portrait consumer; exact whole transaction eligibility is outside this source fragment test.
records.source_meaning: Cargo holds are full; the player must reduce what they are buying.
records.localization_note: Restore the explicit full-holds warning and polite directive in natural sales language. Buy less covers reducing quantity or the selected goods.

records.japanese: あんた、それじゃ金が足りないよ
records.speaker: Market Trader, original contextual town merchant
records.context: Original Market source explicitly binds the cargo-capacity warning749 or transaction funds warning753 to the direct portrait consumer; exact whole transaction eligibility is outside this source fragment test.
records.source_meaning: The player does not have enough money.
records.localization_note: Retain the complete natural funds warning; the familiar direct address does not need a separate English you there.

records.japanese:
シェアがないと交易もできないのに
投資してくれるんですか…
奇特な人だねえ
で、いくら投資してくださるんで？
records.current_English: No local share, yet you still want to invest? That's unusual. How much?
records.english: You can't trade without a market share, but you still want to invest? That's generous of you. How much will you put in?{PAD}
records.speaker: Market Trader, original contextual town merchant
records.context: OriginalBC894 investment path selects763 when local share is positive,762 otherwise; available funds are compared with the native minimum before748; positive supplied amount leads747, zero leads746.
records.source_meaning: Despite having no market share and therefore being unable to trade, the player wants to invest. The merchant praises this admirable generosity and asks how much.
records.localization_note: Restore the source rule that trade requires share and its admiring kitoku rather than the old merely unusual. Preserve the question about amount and omit no trade/investment condition.

records.japanese:
投資してくれるってのかい？
さすが、他の連中とはどこか違うと
思ってたよ
で、いくら投資してもらえるんだ？
records.current_English: Excellent choice. How much will you invest?
records.english: You're going to invest? I knew you were different from the rest! How much will you put in?{PAD}
records.speaker: Market Trader, original contextual town merchant
records.context: OriginalBC894 investment path selects763 when local share is positive,762 otherwise; available funds are compared with the native minimum before748; positive supplied amount leads747, zero leads746.
records.source_meaning: The player offers to invest. The merchant flatters them as different from the others and asks the investment amount.
records.localization_note: Restore the omitted merchant flattery and invitation to invest. Different from the rest is the source praise, not a factual claim about a player trait or faction.

records.japanese:
金が足りないね
慈善じゃないんだ、金がなけりゃ
見せられねえな
records.current_English: Not enough money. Market reports aren't free.
records.english: You don't have enough money. This isn't a charity. You'll have to pay if you want a look.{PAD}
records.speaker: Market Trader, original contextual town merchant
records.context: Original Market caller and direct portrait dispatch are bound by source instructions.764 follows the unsigned available-money/quoted-price failure.765 and766 are distinct consecutive replies in a separate transaction fragment; its complete bonus eligibility is not claimed.
records.source_meaning: Insufficient money. This is not charity; without payment the merchant cannot show what is requested.
records.localization_note: Restore the blunt charity refusal and pay-to-see condition. Keep the object implicit as in Japanese; the source price branch confirms this is a paid viewing request, without adding the identity of a report.

records.japanese:
ついでと言っちゃなんだが
シェアを、少し優遇しといてやるよ
安心しなって、うまくやっとくから
records.current_English: Since you're investing, I'll boost your share a little. Don't worry, I'll handle it.
records.english: I'll give you a little extra market share, too. Don't worry. I'll take care of it.{PAD}
records.speaker: Market Trader, original contextual town merchant
records.context: Original Market caller and direct portrait dispatch are bound by source instructions.764 follows the unsigned available-money/quoted-price failure.765 and766 are distinct consecutive replies in a separate transaction fragment; its complete bonus eligibility is not claimed.
records.source_meaning: As an additional favor the merchant will give a little preferential treatment on market share and reassures the player it will be handled well. Investment is not stated as the cause.
records.localization_note: Remove the invented Since you are investing condition. The Japanese only offers additional preferential market share and reassurance. Do not infer an unproven bonus amount or eligibility trigger from adjacent records.

records.speaker: Market Trader, original contextual town merchant
records.context: Original Market caller and direct portrait dispatch are bound by source instructions.764 follows the unsigned available-money/quoted-price failure.765 and766 are distinct consecutive replies in a separate transaction fragment; its complete bonus eligibility is not claimed.
records.source_meaning: Merchant farewell, looking forward to the player doing business again.
records.localization_note: Retain the idiomatic merchant farewell. It naturally conveys a wish for repeat business without a literal request for help.
